description: This file handles the changing of the status of custom views within the vtiger CRM application. It verifies permissions and updates the database accordingly, returning success or failure messages or permission denial notices.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Class representing custom views in vtiger CRM, used here to check permissions.

methods.name: isPermittedCustomView
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to perform a specific action on a custom view.
